name: o-compare-rust
description: Side-by-side text compare using Tauri, Rust and Monaco

scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:editor && npm run test:folders && npm run test:theme && npm run test:accessibility
scripts.test:editor: node scripts/test-editor.mjs && node scripts/test-tabs.mjs && node scripts/test-tabs-ui.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/test-regex-diff.mjs && node scripts/test-regex-browser.mjs
scripts.test:folders: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --examples && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/test-folder-tree.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/test-folder-model.mjs && node scripts/test-folders-ui.mjs && node scripts/test-folder-controls.mjs && node scripts/test-workspace-features.mjs
scripts.build:win: powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/prepare-explorer.ps1 && tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/package-release.mjs
